messages.summary.hero_claims: {positive} of {total} claims have positive supporting evidence.
messages.summary.run_narrative: Callimachus identified {claims} cited claims and assessed {pairs} claim–source associations across {references} references.
messages.assessment.green.title: Citation support is acceptable
messages.assessment.green.copy: No material citation concern was found. A limited share of partial support and technical verification limits may still be listed below without changing this assessment.
messages.assessment.yellow.title: Material findings require attention
messages.assessment.yellow.copy: The report found a citation concern or manuscript-level coverage uncertainty that requires review.
messages.assessment.red.title: Serious bibliographic problems found
messages.assessment.red.copy: One or more serious deterministic findings were recorded. Do not rely on the highlighted claims or citations until they are resolved.
messages.assessment.red.bibliographic_copy: At least one reference was refuted or is very likely fabricated on deterministic evidence. Do not rely on the manuscript’s citations until the highlighted sources are resolved.
messages.summary.sources_fabricated: refuted or very likely fabricated sources
messages.summary.retracted_sources_copy: This source contributes a material finding to the overall assessment.
messages.attention.orphan_title: Citation without a matching bibliography entry
messages.attention.orphan_copy: Citation marker {marker} could not be linked to a source.
messages.attention.serious_source_copy: Recorded identity status: {status}. This is distinct from an ordinary automatic-search miss.
messages.attention.reference_refuted_copy: {resolver} positively identifies a different work at the cited coordinates ({coordinates}): {work}. This is a documented contradiction, not a search failure.
messages.attention.refutation_complete_issue_copy: {resolver} completed the declared issue inventory and did not find the cited work at {coordinates}. This is a documented absence within that complete issue, not a search failure.
messages.attention.elevated_issue_absence_incompl: {resolver} completed the official issue inventory and excluded the cited work at {coordinates}. Other identity checks remain incomplete, so this establishes absence from that issue only; it does not establish that the work does not exist.
messages.attention.refutation_identifier_not_foun: {resolver} authoritatively reported the cited identifier {identifier} as not found. This is a documented identifier contradiction, not a search failure.
messages.attention.refutation_identifier_other_wo: {resolver} resolved the cited identifier {identifier} to a different work: {work}. This is a documented identifier contradiction, not a search failure.
messages.attention.documented_refutation_copy: {resolver} documented a contradiction for the cited value {cited}. This is not an ordinary search failure.
messages.attention.high_suspicion_copy: {resolver} indexes the declared journal “{journal}”, but its completed search of {scope} found no compatible paper. The same resolver therefore confirms the journal coverage and the bounded article absence.
messages.attention.high_suspicion_fallback: Deterministic bibliographic evidence supports a high fabrication suspicion.
messages.attention.elevated_suspicion_copy: {providers} completed independent searches for “{journal}” without finding a compatible source, but no resolver established a closed article inventory. This is a serious unresolved bibliographic concern, not a fabrication diagnosis.
messages.attention.unconfirmed_copy: Their bibliographic identity was not confirmed automatically.
messages.attention.table_only_copy: They are excluded from semantic verification by policy.
messages.attention.jury1_guard: No accepted semantic result: the Jury 1 output was rejected by the verification guard.
messages.field.title: Title
messages.field.bibliographic_concern_reason: Why it was classified this way
messages.review_label.completed_searches_copy: {label}: {providers} completed independent identity searches without identifying a compatible source. This is informational only, not proof that the reference is fabricated.
messages.review_label.coordinate_copy: {label}: {resolver} completed a lookup by journal, year, volume and first locator without finding a compatible article; the independent identity searches were {providers}. This is informational only, not proof that the reference is fabricated.
messages.review_label.incomplete_bibliographic_so: {label}: the citation lacks an article page, elocator, or article number, and automatic checks could neither identify nor refute it. This is informational only, not proof that the reference is fabricated.
messages.review_label.author_list_discrepancy_cop: {label}: {provider}'s returned author list does not contain the explicitly cited author(s) {authors}. The provider does not attest that this list is complete, so this requires review and does not refute the correctly identified work.
messages.availability.cited_reference_contradicte: Recorded bibliographic evidence contradicts the cited reference. This is not itself a finding of fabrication.
messages.availability.access_blocked_no_text.deta: A recorded paywall or access challenge blocked retrieval after the bibliographic identity was identified.
messages.availability.retrieval_blocked_identity_: A recorded paywall or access challenge blocked retrieval, but the bibliographic identity was not established by that access signal.
messages.availability.known_work_no_text.detail: The bibliographic identity was identified, but no usable text was acquired.
messages.availability.not_found_in_completed_sear: Completed bibliographic searches did not find a compatible work. This is a material warning requiring manual review, but it is not by itself proof of fabrication.
No usable text was acquired and the bibliographic identity remains uncertain.
